title: Normalise Nigerian mobile numbers from messy user input
why_it_matters: Sign-up, OTP and payment flows break when numbers typed as +234(0)803..., 0803-123-4567 or 2348031234567 are stored in different shapes or wrongly accepted.
expected_failure_mode: Models strip non-digits and take the last 10 digits, which accepts garbage, or miss the (0) trunk digit after the country code.
